text: All messages shall be exchanged over MQTT in accordance with ISO/IEC 20922.
Messages shall use JSON in accordance with ISO/IEC 21778 and the Annex A schemas.
Topic structure is /ISO_21423/v1/<entityType>/<entityUuid>/<resourceName>.
Every MQTT broker session shall be persistent.
Last Will and Testament shall use the disconnection topic, QoS 1, retained true, and states LOST_CONNECTION.
A Keep Alive of 60 seconds shall be set.
IMR identity/capability information shall be provided upon start-up or change.
IMR location and status information shall be published when required status data changes.
IMRFM identity/capability information shall be provided upon start-up or change.
IMRFM state message shall be sent when state information changes.
IMR or IMRFM shall be capable of sending and receiving request and requestStatus messages.
IMRs or IMRFMs that can report location shall support move, pauseImr, resumeImr, and cancel request messages.
Receiver responds with requestStatus upon any state change for the request.
Status updates shall be sent only if state changes, not periodically.
When terminal, the last requestStatus indicates CANCELED, SUCCEEDED, or ABORTED.
When a request reaches terminal state, retained request is cleared by publishing zero-byte payload to same topic.
An entity managing other entities shall publish data for each entity following each entity topic structure.
All fleets operating in the same physical space shall use the same common coordinate system.
At least three reference points per CCS shall be identified.
All UUIDs shall conform with ISO/IEC 9834-8.
